name: Lieutenant Governor High School Internship Program
org: Office of the Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii
what_you_do: Spend five summer weeks at the State Capitol, in person, and learn how state government works.
who_can_apply: Hawaii residents who are 16 by the start, have finished sophomore year, and are full-time high school students. Students from any island can apply but must pay for their own housing and travel.
duration: 5 weeks, Tuesdays and Thursdays, 9am to noon
deadline_text: The 2026 internship ran June 15 to July 16, 2026. Its deadline was Apr 15, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application. Email it with your unofficial transcript, one letter of recommendation and an essay of 500 to 700 words. Send it to ltgov.internships@hawaii.gov. Some students are then interviewed.
notes: Very small group: the page says six students are picked. The page and form differ on the start date (June 15 or June 16), and its FAQ still shows some 2025 dates, so confirm with the office.
